mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the link's operating load against usable battery capacity was the most worthwhile passage: it turned an independence claim into a concrete overnight plan with a margin and a follow-up check.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequential battery and power-box preparations were clear but felt routine, especially with only one combination offered at each point.

surprise.text: The old wall adapter was still a dependency even after the radios had protected reserves; disconnecting it made the independence requirement more concrete.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though most power steps were the only offered action, so they involved little meaningful choice.

continue.text: Yes. Eli's reply gives the repair a personal payoff, and Tin Row's offer makes me curious about how the separate networks might communicate.
